from fastmcp import Server
import uvicorn

# Create the MCP server
server = Server(name="health-check-example")

# Add health check endpoint (plain HTTP, outside MCP protocol)
@server.app.get("/health")
async def health_check():
    return {"status": "ok"}

# Example MCP tool
@server.tool()
def greet(name: str) -> str:
    """Greet someone"""
    return f"Hello {name}!"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    uvicorn.run(server.app, host="0.0.0.0", port=8000)
